description: issue #874's headline symptom, in the profile that owns it: with `turtle-rendering` active, `(home 10)` supplies one input to a Kind-C command that takes none (`spec/commands.md:1283`), so `check()` raises ol-too-many-inputs at the semantic stage. It used to check completely CLEAN while `execute()` raised the same code at the runtime stage for the identical program, because the static arity rule hand-wrote one profile branch at a time and Turtle & Rendering had none. This fixture lives under turtle-rendering/ and declares the profile so the check actually runs with it active — the half of the agreement a Core-only fixture cannot exercise. Its runtime twin for the sibling command is turtle-rendering/screen/clear-screen-too-many-inputs.
